data.narrative: Exemplary mid-build adaptation demonstrated under compounding scope changes. Accurately modeled blast radius across services, defended scope cuts to protect the critical 6-day delivery milestone, and successfully upgraded the delegation architecture from a minimal bridge to scoped JWT-based RBAC.

dimension_scores.observation: Unpacked subtle corporate multi-tenancy and RBAC delegation requirements from stakeholder requests without missing unstated authorization and schema boundaries.
dimension_scores.evidence: Identified org_id and department_id scoping rules and employee/manager/dept_head permission models in artifacts/adaptation-break.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Traced blast radius impacts accurately through dependency chains, keeping independent subsystems isolated from auth/booking churn.
dimension_scores.evidence: Preserved Search and Catalog tickets while cleanly isolating changes to Booking API and User schema in artifacts/adaptation/module-07-blast-radius.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Distinguished critical delivery path risks from non-blocking features and made principled scope cuts.
dimension_scores.evidence: Explicitly cut analytics dashboard and fuzzy search while preserving the core booking vertical slice in artifacts/adaptation/module-07-updated-plan.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Formulated precise, executable task tickets for added and modified tickets with sizing and clear boundaries.
dimension_scores.evidence: Created sized tickets with concrete scopes in artifacts/adaptation/module-07-updated-plan.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Rapidly adapted execution plans across two consecutive scope changes without panicking or discarding completed work.
dimension_scores.evidence: Layered second requirement change directly onto the initial adaptation plan in artifacts/adaptation-break.md and artifacts/adaptation-fix.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Engineered claim-based RBAC token design that seamlessly integrates with existing booking flows without breaking individual booking contracts.
dimension_scores.evidence: Architected backwards-compatible delegation payload and 403 Forbidden handling in artifacts/adaptation-fix.md.

strengths: Flawless blast radius assessment tracing cascading dependency impacts across services.
Principled scope management and descope defense preserving critical path delivery dates.
Seamless layering of complex RBAC architecture over initial adaptation without plan collapse.
data.recommendation: Proceed directly to Module 8 Integration and Verification to validate end-to-end multi-agent outputs against adapted requirements.

public_evidence.student_action: Adapted execution backlog under tight deadline constraints, performing blast radius analysis and updating task contracts for corporate RBAC.
public_evidence.technical_detail: JWT token claims and booking delegation authorization middleware
public_evidence.ability: Mid-Build Requirement Adaptation and Backlog Rescoping
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates engineering leadership and composure under shifting stakeholder requirements.

teaching_approaches.detail: Layered multi-tenant RBAC requirements over initial plan
